topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; CPAs bound by professional ethics; confidentiality agreement at hire, but it does not describe IRC 7216 and 6713 penalties
gap: Agreement silent on IRC 7216 and 6713; seasonal preparers sign after access
remediation: Updated agreement and 7216 acknowledgment before access (POL-05 4.2; P03 G-043)

control_description: Partner Group is the governing body under 314.4(i); the Qualified Individual has never reported to it in writing
gap: No written report or recorded security oversight by the Partner Group
remediation: First written report 2026-10-20, then annually; security on the partner meeting agenda quarterly

control_description: Qualified Individual designated in writing; roles, reporting lines, and risk acceptance authority set in POL-01
Background checks for all hires including seasonal staff; security is a part-time duty of the IT Manager; no check that security staff stay current
gap: No verification that security personnel keep current (314.4(e)(4)); seasonal staff start before training
remediation: Annual training plan for the IT Manager and MSP; training before access (POAM-013)

control_description: Sanctions set in POL-01 4.11; policy acknowledgments due 2026-10-31
gap: Acknowledgments not yet collected; sanctions never applied under the new policy
remediation: Collect acknowledgments from all staff

control_description: Risk register, BIA, and SSP give the program its information; asset inventory incomplete and logs not reviewed
gap: No single inventory of SaaS services, network devices, and printer-scanners; logs unused
remediation: Complete the inventory (P03 G-012) and the log workspace (POAM-004)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved and published 2026-08-31; incident line not yet communicated
gap: 6 of 10 staff could not say how to report an incident (P07)
remediation: Publish the incident line; brief all staff (POAM-017)

control_description: Engagement letters, portal terms, and IRC 7216 consents define commitments to clients; no standard answer set for client security questionnaires
gap: Client security questions answered ad hoc; no stated security contact
remediation: Use this self-benchmark as the standard response; name the IT Manager as security contact

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Security objectives set in POL-01; business objectives and recovery targets set in the BIA
Written risk assessment with 33 risks rated using NIST SP 800-30 (P01), meeting 314.4(b)(1)
Fraud risks assessed in P01: refund diversion (R-002), fraudulent returns (R-003), vendor payment fraud (R-025), insider misuse (R-026)
No change management or pre-adoption security review; the AI extraction feature was enabled without an assessment
gap: No process to identify and assess significant changes (314.4(c)(4), (c)(7))
remediation: Change log and pre-adoption review checklist, including AI features (P03 G-014, G-018)

control_description: Independent control assessment performed 2026-08 (P07); no penetration test and no vulnerability scan since 2025-03
gap: 314.4(d)(2) testing not in place
remediation: Monthly scans and annual penetration test (POAM-006, POAM-007)

control_description: POA&M with owners and dates, reviewed monthly by the Firm Administrator; High items approved by the Managing Partner

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP from the risk assessment; many treatments are funded but not yet implemented
gap: 11 SSP controls are only planned
remediation: Implement the funded Q4 2026 treatments

control_description: General IT controls over identity, endpoints, and backups exist; change management and monitoring do not
gap: Change and monitoring controls missing
remediation: See CC7.2 and CC8.1

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Five policies approved (P06); several supporting procedures missing (access review, seasonal onboarding, call-back, change)
gap: Procedures not written
remediation: Write the four procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with push MFA for staff; provider encryption at rest; laptops encrypted; legacy authentication still open on 4 service mailboxes; 12 desktops unencrypted
gap: MFA bypass and unencrypted desktops
remediation: Block legacy authentication and enable number matching (POAM-002); encrypt desktops (POAM-015)

control_description: Accounts created from approved HR tickets; seasonal accounts have no end date; client portal MFA optional
evidence: HR tickets; IdP export; portal report
gap: Seasonal end dates missing; 62% of clients without MFA
remediation: End dates at creation (POAM-001); mandatory client MFA (POAM-012)

control_description: Role-based tax software roles exist; partners hold standing global admin rights; all tax staff can open every client folder; access removed late
evidence: Admin role report; DMS permission export
gap: Least privilege and timely removal not in place
remediation: Team-based DMS access and separate admin accounts (POAM-003); same-day disable (POAM-001)

control_description: Badge entry at both offices; server and network closet locked with 3 key holders; visitors escorted
Paper shredded with certificates; no retention schedule; printer-scanner drives not wiped at lease end
gap: Client files kept since 2009; drive disposal not controlled
remediation: Retention schedule and first purge (POAM-019); wipe certificates (POAM-020)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewalls at both offices; only the VPN gateway is exposed; MSP remote tool unrestricted; VPN firmware was behind until 2026-08-06
gap: MSP tool and VPN patching not controlled
remediation: Restrict the MSP tool (POAM-008); monthly scans (POAM-006)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for the tax software, portal, and e-file; returns emailed as plain attachments on request
gap: Unencrypted email attachments
remediation: Portal or enforced encryption only (POAM-014)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all endpoints and cloud VMs; standard users cannot install software; USB storage blocked unless approved

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Ad hoc vulnerability scanning (last 2025-03); no configuration baselines for firewalls, VPN, or cloud workloads
gap: No scanning cadence or baseline
remediation: Monthly scans (POAM-006); documented baselines

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: EDR watched in business hours only; no monitoring of sign-ins, inbox rules, or bulk downloads
gap: After-hours and identity and email events not monitored
remediation: 24x7 managed detection and response (POAM-005); log workspace (POAM-004)

control_description: Events handled ad hoc by the IT Manager and MSP; triage criteria now in the P08 runbook
gap: No security ticket category; no triage record
remediation: Security ticket category (POAM-016)

control_description: Written incident response plan (POL-03 and P08) approved 2026-08-31, with regulatory clocks; never exercised
gap: Untested; staff not briefed
remediation: Tabletop before the filing season (POAM-016, POAM-017)

control_description: Immutable backups in a second region; one DMS restore in 2025; workpaper server never restored; no recovery procedures
gap: Recovery unproven
remediation: Quarterly restore tests (POAM-018); recovery procedures in the contingency plan

control_description: No change management procedure for firewall, VPN, cloud, or SaaS configuration changes
gap: Changes are not authorized, tested, or logged
remediation: Change log with approvals (P03 G-018)

control_description: BIA approved (P05); cyber insurance in force; no contingency plan or deadline contingency procedure
gap: No contingency plan
remediation: Contingency plan with the deadline procedure (P01 R-019, R-021)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Tax software SOC 2 Type 2 reviewed (Part B); no provider inventory; MSP contract has no security terms; AI sub-processor unreviewed
gap: Vendor oversight required by 314.4(f) not in place
remediation: Inventory, contract terms, and annual reviews (POAM-010, POAM-008)
